home.title: Garcete Suárez Ronco - Criminal Defense Lawyers in Buenos Aires
home.description: Law firm specializing in Ordinary, Federal, Economic and Penal Execution Law. Cerrito 1054, CABA.

estudio.slide1: Criminal law is our core. We act in defense of the accused and in representation of prosecutors in ordinary and federal courts, with a trajectory in high-profile cases and technical demand.
estudio.slide2: Criminal specialization does not prevent us from providing a complete legal response. We have experience in civil, commercial, and labor law to accompany our clients beyond the criminal court, covering the spectrum of their needs with the same level of demand.
estudio.slide3: We practice law with responsibility and proximity. Every client has direct access to the firm's partners and receives clear information about the status of their case, ensuring they always know where they stand and what comes next.

areas.label: Practice Areas
areas.area1Text: We act as defense and as prosecution in all types of crimes before the criminal courts of the City and the Province of Buenos Aires. Our practice covers crimes against property, physical and sexual integrity, cybercrimes - among others -, acting in all stages of the process.
areas.area2Text: With an enabling license in the federal court, we intervene in high-complexity cases before the federal justice throughout the national territory, with special expertise in crimes related to narcotics and public administration.
areas.area3Text: We advise and represent natural and legal persons in cases involving economic crimes: fraud, tax evasion, money laundering, crimes related to crypto-assets, and corporate criminal liability. We also accompany in compliance programs to prevent the criminal exposure of companies and their executives.
areas.area4Text: We intervene in the sentence execution stage to guarantee the full exercise of the convicted person's rights, processing every institute provided in the penitentiary progressiveness regime.

socios.label: Partners
socios.matiasBio: A graduate of the University of Buenos Aires, Matías oriented his practice towards strategic criminal litigation in high-complexity cases. His approach is distinguished by the design of precise legal solutions, with a special focus on negotiation and the construction of strategies that anticipate every move of the process. His trajectory includes the representation of figures from entertainment, television, and public life, which forged in him a singular capacity to manage high-exposure cases with the discretion and rigor that each situation demands.
socios.benjaminBio: A graduate of the University of Buenos Aires and a Master's candidate in Criminal Law at the University of San Andrés, Benjamín built a trajectory of more than a decade in the Federal Criminal and Correctional court, intervening in high-complexity and high-impact cases. A specialist in narcotics and federal crimes, with a distinguished performance in oral trials, he represents his clients with the technical rigor and conviction that only comes from experience accumulated in the most demanding stages of the criminal system.
